newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Court says states may reclassify facts in time context.
newsitem.headline: Court says states may reclassify facts in time context.

text.p: The European Court of Justice said on Thursday Community customs provisions do not preclude member states from reclassifying facts at the time of violation, when setting penalties.
The French government initated proceedings in 1990 against an importer who falsely declared the origin of steel beams and plates as Yugoslavia, and not the former German Democratic Republic, in 1985.

At the time France initiated its prosecution, the former East Germany had united with West Germany. The court noted that as soon as Germany was unified, all Community provisions applied to the former eastern state as well.

"However, it must be stressed that the extension of the Community customs territory ... constitutes a new material fact which does not have the effect of releasing member states from obligation to ... guarantee Community law ... such an extension does not preclude national courts from penalizing breaches of Community legislation on conditions ...which make the penalty effective, proportionate and dissuasive, " the court said.
The court's decision will permit the French court to look at the facts under national law at the time of the customs' breach.
(Court translation into English. Original language of the case: French)
"Customs declaration - Country of origin - German unification - Penalties"
Reference by the Cour d'Appel, Paris, for a preliminary ruling in the criminal proceedings before that court against
Steel Trading France SARL, as a party liable at civil law

on the consequences to be drawn, following the unification of the Federal Republic of Germany and the German Democratic Republic and the rest of the Community's customs territory with regard to the possible reclassification of facts for the purpose of imposing penalties

The Community customs provisions, applicable following the unification of the Federal Republic of Germany and the German Democratic Republic, do not preclude a reclassificatin of facts under national law with a view to penalizing breaches of the Community legislation applicable at the material time.
